function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The analysis was adjusted to perform stratified comparisons within each customer segment (loyal, returning, new). This controls for the confounding effect of customer segment, which is imbalanced between channels. The raw difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) was 0.0698, but within each segment, the difference is negative: -0.1891 (loyal), -0.0694 (returning), and -0.1612 (new). This indicates that, within each segment, the paid_search channel outperformed email. Therefore, the initial higher overall conversion rate for email was due to its targeting of higher-value segments, not campaign effectiveness.
